Name: Seasonal Junimo Catalog tweaks
Author: farmerbeans
Description:
[b][size=5]Your Junimo Catalog changes with the seasons!
[/size]
[/b]The Junimo Catalog is great to decorate with, but when the seasons change, the original green foliage looks a little out-of-place outdoors. This mod patches that and adds some aesthetic tweaks to make the catalog even more fun to use. 

[size=5][b]Features[/b]
[/size][list]
[*]Junimo End Table has alternate "flower pot" appearance when rotated
[*]Small, medium and large Junimo Huts match the Junimo Hut building style
[*]Foliage changes with the season
[*]Junimo Flower and bundle color changes with the season
[*]Table and stool are mushroomy
[*]Paintings and rugs are a little more colorful
[/list]
[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size][list]
[*]Content Patcher
[/list][size=5][b]How to Use
[/b][/size][list]
[*]Obtain the Junimo Catalog in-game. Decorate away!
[/list]

Downloads.Description: v 1.0.2: Huts now look better when placed in warm climates, like Ginger Island, Calico Desert and Crimson Badlands.
